title: ThredUp Expands Resale-as-a-Service® Partnership with Pact and Fillogic
summary: ThredUp brings Pact’s pre-loved, GOTS-certified organic styles directly onto thredup.com via a three-way collaboration uniting marketplace, brand, and 3PL logistics
body_markdown:
**OAKLAND, Calif. and BOULDER, Colo. – October 12, 2026** – ThredUp Inc., the largest online resale platform for apparel, shoes and accessories, today announced an expanded partnership with Pact, the Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) certified organic apparel brand based in Boulder, Colorado. Starting today, Pact’s pre-loved styles are listed directly on ThredUp’s marketplace, reaching its 1.7 million active buyers. The full Pact collection is available at[thredup.com/pact](http://thredup.com/pact) .


Pact has worked with ThredUp since 2025 through ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service® (RaaS) platform, which lets Pact customers trade in gently used items for store credit. This new integration builds on that relationship: Pact’s resale inventory is now merchandised, listed and dropshipped directly onto ThredUp’s consumer marketplace for the first time. The initiative is powered in collaboration with Pact’s reverse logistics partner Fillogic. Fillogic’s platform enables automated item serialization, grading, listing, and fulfillment directly through ThredUp’s marketplace within days of return, unlocking margin recovery for Pact.


“Brands shouldn’t have to build a resale business from scratch to give their products a second life,” said Alon Rotem, Chief Strategy Officer at ThredUp. “Our Resale-as–Service platform lets brands like Pact plug their existing 3PL and reverse logistics partners straight into ThredUp’s marketplace, where millions of shoppers are already looking for secondhand. With Fillogic, Pact has created a blueprint for how brands can move items from return to resale in days.”


“We make clothes to live in, not to throw away,” added Brendan Synnott, CEO of Pact. “Every Pact piece is certified to the Global Organic Textile Standard, and that doesn’t expire when it changes hands. Resale on ThredUp gives our clothes a second life and puts certified organic apparel within reach of more people. Wellness shouldn’t be a luxury.”


“Fillogic’s partnership with Pact and ThredUp means that every item is directed to its highest-value outcome in a single touch — recovering value for the brand and extending the life of the product,” said Bill Thayer, CEO of Fillogic “Our proprietary serialized intake, grading and routing at the point of return makes brand-direct resale economics work.”


Brands interested in ThredUp’s direct marketplace integrations and resale solutions can contact us atraas@thredup.com .


**About ThredUp**


ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first, embracing the idea that the past is the future, and the future starts today. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes, and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice, all while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium, and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems, and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 250 million unique secondhand items from 60,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry—a future where the future of fashion feels good.


**ThredUp Media Contact:**media@thredup.com


**About Pact**


Pact is on a mission to dress the world in wellness. Founded in 2009 and based in Boulder, Colorado, Pact makes everyday essentials certified to the Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), from underwear and bras to sleepwear, activewear and tees. Because what you wear closest to your skin matters. Learn more at[wearpact.com](https://www.wearpact.com/) .


**About Fillogic**


Fillogic helps brands and retailers recover more value from their inventory. Fillogic turns retail space into tech-enabled local hubs for end-to-end forward and reverse logistics, processing returns, RTVs and excess inventory close to where they originate. Each item is graded at receipt and routed to restock, resale, or sustainable disposition, getting goods back to market in days rather than weeks. Learn more at[fillogic.com](https://www.fillogic.com/) .
